RQ-04.code:
FINDINGS
- src/components/BookCard/BookCard.tsx:16 `onKeyDown`
  Cause: [clarity] Logical `&&` used as control flow is less readable than an explicit conditional
  Current: onKeyDown={(e) => (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') && onClick(book.id)}
  Fix: onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') onClick(book.id); }}

- src/components/BookCard/BookCard.tsx:11 `<article role="button">`
  Cause: [clarity] `role="button"` overrides the implicit ARIA role of `<article>`, conflicting with its sectioning semantics; prefer a neutral element like `<div>` or an actual `<button>` for interactive cards
  Current: <article className="book-card" role="button" ...>
  Fix: <div className="book-card" role="button" ...>
